source_refs.note: 2. Peripatric Speciation: a main subheading of 1.8 Species and speciation, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 33-33.

blocks.text: Is mein ek bari aabadi ke kinare (edge) par ek chhoti, alag ho chuki aabadi hoti hai. Yeh chhoti aabadi tezi se evolutionary tabdeeliyon se guzarti hai aur asal aabadi se mukhtalif (divergent) ho jati hai. Misal: jazeeron (islands) ki woh species jo ek chhoti founding population (shuru mein aa kar basne wali chhoti aabadi) se evolve hoti hain.
